summary: Rahu in the lagna gives a strong, unusual, self-driven personality with worldly drive and resilience against rivals, but classical texts warn of health weakness, especially of the head and face, and modern authors of unsettled marriage and self-image.
common_outcomes: Strength, power or wealth (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha; Foss name 64 'tremendous power')
Overcomes enemies or competitors (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha)
Health that is hard to diagnose or treat conventionally; head and face complaints (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Braha)
Odd, eccentric or out-of-the-ordinary personality, interest in the occult (Raman HJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika 8.25: a short life despite wealth and strength
Bhrigu Sutras 1-4: in Aries, Taurus or Cancer, kind-hearted and fond of enjoyments; aspected by a malefic, marks on the face
Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): remains under others' influence and stays detached despite many marriages
Braha: often gives striking good looks

by_area.personality: Wilful, with a 'hypocritical super-consciousness' towards others; odd and eccentric (Raman HJH); big ego with fragile confidence and a lifelong struggle for self-acceptance (Braha); obliging, sympathetic and courageous (Hindu Predictive Astrology).
by_area.health: Diseases of the head and face (Phaladeepika 8.25); health generally unsatisfactory, calling for non-medical remedies (Raman HJH); illness from upset emotions, hard to diagnose (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Usually bad for marriage (Raman HJH); constant ups and downs in married life; spouse may be spiritual or devious (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Inclines one to the occult (Raman HJH); inclined to spiritual or occult subjects (Braha).

strengtheners: Rahu in Aries, Taurus or Cancer in the lagna: protects from the evils of the chart (Saravali 12.10-11); with benefic aspect 'no evil exists' (Garga Hora GP 25; Raman HJH)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: honour, fame, leadership (Braha); Foss reports a text saying Rahu in Gemini in the 1st removes all afflictions
Rahu in a kendra connected with a kendra/trikona lord becomes a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52); in a kendra or trikona Rahu is said to lead to religious sacrifices (BPHS 21.3)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in Cancer or Leo heightens the negatives (Braha) — note this conflicts with Saravali's listing of Cancer as protective
Rahu aspected by a malefic: facial marks (Bhrigu Sutras 1-4)
Rahu or Ketu in the lagna while the lagna lord is in the 6th, 8th or 12th: bodily trouble in the lagna lord's dasa (Jataka Parijata 11.31)
lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is always in the 7th, so marriage readings must include Ketu in 7. Raman HJH: Rahu here 'partakes of the characteristics of Saturn' (cf. Phaladeepika 8.34). Braha says Rahu gives its full effects around the 42nd year. Node dignity is disputed: Raman (Hindu Predictive Astrology) gives Rahu's exaltation as Taurus, while Braha says the only placements agreed upon are Mercury's signs Gemini and Virgo and treats Cancer and Leo as weak for the nodes.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.25 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Short-lived but wealthy and strong; suffers diseases of the head and face.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 1-4 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 1st: the spouse may lose a pregnancy; in Aries, Taurus or Cancer, kind-hearted and fond of enjoyment; aspected by a malefic, marks on the face. (The Sutras give one result for either node.)

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 1st (Rahu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Destroys the power of enemies, remains under others' influence, stays detached despite many wives.

source_views.source: Saravali (Kalyana Varma) 12.10-11 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: Rahu in the lagna in Aries, Taurus or Cancer protects the native from the chart's evils, as a pleased king forgives crimes.

source_views.source: Garga Hora, 'General Principles' v. 25 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: Rahu in the lagna in Aries, Taurus or Cancer aspected by a benefic: no evil exists in the horoscope.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 21.3 (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1)
source_views.view: If Rahu is in an angle or trine the native performs religious sacrifices such as Jyotishtoma (Santhanam: when Rahu is strongly disposed, the native is very religious and meritorious).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha) 11.31 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1932, vol. II)
source_views.view: Ketu or Rahu in the lagna with the lagna lord in a dusthana: privation of some limb in the lagna lord's dasa and 6th lord's antardasa.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the first house ('Planets in the First House')
source_views.view: Health generally unsatisfactory, needing non-medical treatment; occult leaning; marked wilfulness; odd and eccentric; usually bad for marriage; Rahu takes on Saturn's character.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Obliging, sympathetic, courageous; also lists a miscarriage indication.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Rahu in the 1st house' section
source_views.view: Bad for domestic happiness; health, longevity and confidence weakened; egocentric yet insecure; eccentric; wealthy; occult interest; illnesses from emotions; physical strength and strong will; defeats competitors; often good looks. Gemini/Virgo: honour and leadership.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Rahu, the North Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 64
source_views.view: 'Svagrahe prabaladhyadaya': in the 1st house Rahu gives tremendous power; Foss adds that one text says Rahu in Gemini in the 1st removes all afflictions.

source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika 8.25 gives short life, whereas Saravali 12 and Garga Hora treat Rahu in the lagna in Aries, Taurus or Cancer as protective. Braha regards Cancer as a weak sign for Rahu, contradicting that Saravali list. Hindu Predictive Astrology is mildly positive in character (obliging, sympathetic), Raman HJH more negative (wilful, hypocritical).
phrasing_guidance: Describe a magnetic, unconventional drive for self-making, with advice to ground ambition in routine and self-care. Avoid predictions about lifespan, pregnancy loss or specific illnesses; mention partnership balance (Ketu in the 7th) gently.

summary: Rahu in the 2nd unsettles speech, family harmony, diet and finances; texts swing between poverty and wealth gained through the ruler, friends or business, with Jupiter's influence the main stabiliser.
common_outcomes: Ambiguous, insincere or harsh speech (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha)
Friction or disturbance in family life (Raman HJH; Braha; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras)
Uncertain finances (Raman HJH; Bhrigu Sutras 5-6; Braha)
Disease or marks of the mouth, face or eyes (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Bhrigu Sutras 5-6)
rare_outcomes: Wealth through the ruler or government (Phaladeepika 8.25)
Foss name 88: in the 2nd Rahu gives the position and insignia of royalty (high position or abundant wealth)
More than one marriage if afflicted (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Fondness for rich dinners, alcohol or meat (Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)

by_area.personality: Quick to anger yet tender-hearted (Phaladeepika 8.25); peevish (Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology); fearless but untruthful (Chamatkar Chintamani); vivid, peculiar imagination (Braha).
by_area.finance: Uncertain unless other good combinations; good earnings if Jupiter aspects the 2nd; gains through friends and business (Raman HJH). Poverty (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6); wealth through the sovereign (Phaladeepika 8.25); craving for money, phenomenal wealth possible if well disposed (Braha). Rath: Rahu in the 2nd does not by itself cause poverty yoga; it is formed when Jupiter is 2nd, 5th, 9th or 12th from Rahu.
by_area.health: Mouth or face disease (Phaladeepika 8.25); danger to eyesight (Raman HJH); right-eye problems, facial scars (Braha).
by_area.relationships: Domestic quarrels or separation from the spouse (Braha).
by_area.family: Friction in family life (Raman HJH); destruction of the family line in Chamatkar Chintamani's wording; loss of children (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6).

strengtheners: Jupiter's aspect on the 2nd (Raman HJH)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: great wealth, fine education, poetic or speaking talent (Braha)
Rahu in the 2nd associated with or aspected by the 5th or 9th lord: wealth and longevity in its dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Jupiter in the 2nd, 5th, 9th or 12th from Rahu forms Daridra (poverty) yoga (Rath)
Association with a malefic: marks on the lips (Bhrigu Sutras 5-6)
A malefic joined with the 2nd/7th lord while a node is in the 2nd/7th is treated as dangerous in the node's dasa (Uttara Kalamrita Kanda I, sec. 6, sl. 14-15)
lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 8th. Braha calls this one of Rahu's worst positions and adds that whenever the nodes are in the 2nd or 8th, happiness is disturbed. Node dignity is disputed: Raman (Hindu Predictive Astrology) gives Rahu's exaltation as Taurus, while Braha says the only placements agreed upon are Mercury's signs Gemini and Virgo and treats Cancer and Leo as weak for the nodes.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.25 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Ambiguous or insincere speech, disease of mouth or face, tender-hearted, wealth through the sovereign, wrathful yet happy.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. 9 (Rahu and Ketu), sutras 5-6 (English tr. with commentary; archive.org scan, translator not named in the OCR)
source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 2nd: poverty, bodily disease, loss of children, dark complexion; with a malefic, a mark on the lips.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 2nd (Rahu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Destruction of the family; fearless but a liar; destroys enemies to protect wealth.

source_views.source: Uttara Kalamrita (Kalidasa) Kanda I, section 6, slokas 14-15 (tr. S.S. Sareen)
source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 2nd or 7th with or aspected by the lord of the 5th or 9th gives wealth and longevity; if instead a malefic joins the 2nd or 7th lord, their dasa is dangerous.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events (Sagar), discussion of Daridra yoga
source_views.view: Rahu's mere presence in the 2nd does not cause Daridra yoga; it arises when Jupiter is in the 2nd, 5th, 9th or 12th from Rahu, and Rahu so placed from a 2nd-house Jupiter can obstruct Jupiter's wealth yoga.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the second house ('Planets in the Second House')
source_views.view: Peevish, diseased face, family friction, danger to eyesight, finances uncertain unless other good combinations; Jupiter's aspect gives good earnings through friends and business.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Poor, more than one wife if afflicted, dark complexion, diseased face, peevish, luxurious dinners.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Rahu in the 2nd house' section
source_views.view: One of Rahu's worst positions: depressive tendency, family quarrels or separation, poor food or intoxicants, lying or foul speech, facial scars or right-eye problems; craves wealth, phenomenal wealth possible if well disposed. Gemini/Virgo: great wealth and learning.

source_views.source: Andrew Foss, The Yoga of the Planets: Rahu, the North Node (commentary on the 108-name list of the graha), names 88
source_views.view: 'Dhane kakutprada': in the 2nd house Rahu gives the position and insignia of royalty; Foss notes this can mean abundant material wealth.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika gives wealth via the ruler and Foss's name-list gives royal position, while Bhrigu Sutras and Hindu Predictive Astrology give poverty and Braha calls it one of Rahu's worst houses. Rath clarifies that the placement alone does not make poverty.
phrasing_guidance: Talk about learning to steady speech, diet and spending, and about family dynamics needing patience. Frame money as variable rather than poor; note Jupiter's role if present. Avoid predicting family breakdown or loss of children.

summary: Rahu in the 3rd, an upachaya house, is one of its best placements: courage, initiative, strong will, wealth and long life, at the cost of harmony with siblings.
common_outcomes: Courageous, bold, strong-willed (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha)
Wealth and long life (Phaladeepika 8.25; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Strained relations with, or few, siblings (Phaladeepika 8.25; Raman HJH; Braha)
Fulfilment of efforts and desires (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Abundance of oilseeds/produce (Bhrigu Sutras 7-8); with a benefic, a mark on the neck
Severe criticism for one's views; sudden, unexpected news (Raman HJH)
Gymnastic or physical skill; many relations (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Talent in organising, writing, music or drama (Braha)

by_area.personality: Proud, strong-willed (Phaladeepika 8.25); 'brave for outward appearances' (Raman HJH); adventurous, excited, motivated (Braha).
by_area.career: Ability in organisational or detail work, communication, fine arts; Gemini/Virgo may give work as a producer or director (Braha).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.25); very wealthy (Hindu Predictive Astrology); favours wealth and respect (Braha).
by_area.family: Hostile to brothers (Phaladeepika 8.25); generally bad for brothers (Raman HJH); few younger siblings or no happiness from them (Braha); few children (Hindu Predictive Astrology).

strengtheners: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th aspected by benefics destroys all evils (Saravali 12.3-5); counteracts other negative combinations (Raman HJH)
Malefics in upachaya houses give good results (Uttara Kalamrita 4.16; Braha)
Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: greater courage, artistic and communicative excellence (Braha)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Bhrigu Sutras 7-8 gives only a neutral or minor result, so the strong positive reading rests on Phaladeepika and later authors
Sibling matters remain the weak point even when Rahu is strong (Braha)
lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 9th. Uttara Kalamrita 4.9 does not list the 3rd among Rahu's favourable houses (it lists 4, 7, 8, 10, 11) but reserves the 3rd as Ketu's best house.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.25 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Proud, hostile to siblings, strong-willed, long-lived and wealthy.

source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 3rd: abundance of oilseeds such as mustard and sesame; with a benefic, a mark on the neck.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 3rd (Rahu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Very courageous.

source_views.source: Saravali (Kalyana Varma) 12.3-5 (tr. R. Santhanam)
source_views.view: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th from the lagna aspected by benefics destroys all evils, as wind carries away cotton.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, chapter on the third house ('Planets in the Third House')
source_views.view: Brave in appearance, sudden unexpected news, generally bad for brothers, may be severely criticised for his views. (p. ~209: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th or 11th counteracts other affliction.)

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology, ch. XXI 'Planets in Different Bhavas' (pp. 198-203)
source_views.view: Few children, very wealthy, bold, adventurous, courageous, good at gymnastics, many relations.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer (1986), 'Rahu in the 3rd house' section
source_views.view: Very well placed: adventurous, courageous, firm personality, cravings to communicate, wealth and respect, fulfilment of efforts, organisational skill, literary or artistic talent, long life; the only bad effect is few or unhappy relations with younger siblings.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.34 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: It is declared by the authorities that Rahu gives results like Saturn and Ketu like Mars.

disagreements: Classical support for Rahu by house is thin: Brihat Jataka and Saravali give no house-by-house results for the nodes (as the Bhrigu Sutras commentator also notes); Phaladeepika 8.25-27 and the Bhrigu Sutras (which give one combined result for Rahu or Ketu) are the main per-house classical statements, supplemented by scattered rules in Saravali 12, BPHS, Jataka Parijata and Uttara Kalamrita. Phaladeepika, Raman, Braha and Saravali 12 agree that the 3rd is good for Rahu; the Bhrigu Sutras give only a minor material result. Uttara Kalamrita 4.9 omits the 3rd from Rahu's good houses.
phrasing_guidance: A confident placement to describe: initiative, nerve and success through one's own efforts and communication. Mention sibling relationships as needing care, without predicting estrangement.

summary: Rahu in the 4th disturbs inner contentment, the home and the relationship with the mother, with restless cravings for property and comfort; a minority of texts (Uttara Kalamrita, Chamatkar Chintamani in certain signs) rate it favourable.
common_outcomes: Happiness only occasional; restless or troubled mind (Phaladeepika 8.25; Braha)
Difficulties around the mother or her health (Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Braha; Foss name 66)
Strong desire for land or home that is not easily satisfied (Braha)
Fraud suffered or committed; few friends (Raman HJH)
rare_outcomes: Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): in Aries, Cancer or Virgo, beneficial results and royal status
Bhrigu Sutras 9-10: many ornaments, two marriages, serves others
Proficiency in foreign (European) languages; subordinate position (Hindu Predictive Astrology)
Gemini/Virgo: exceptional homes and a strong, beneficial mother (Braha)

by_area.personality: Foolish in behaviour (Raman HJH; Phaladeepika 8.25); insatiable cravings for worldly benefits that disturb contentment (Braha).
by_area.career: Subordinate service (Hindu Predictive Astrology; Bhrigu Sutras 9-10).
by_area.relationships: Few friends (Raman HJH); two wives (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10).
by_area.family: Mother sickly (Chamatkar Chintamani); mother in distress if Rahu is with a malefic, not with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10); difficulties with a mother who may lead a troubled life (Braha); disputes with relatives or over property (Foss name 81).

strengtheners: Association with a benefic protects the mother (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10)
Rahu in Aries, Cancer or Virgo (Chamatkar Chintamani); Gemini or Virgo (Braha)
Uttara Kalamrita 4.9 lists the 4th among Rahu's favourable houses
Kendra placement connected with a kendra/trikona lord makes the node a yogakaraka (Phaladeepika 20, sl. ~52); BPHS 21.3 (Rahu in an angle leads to religious sacrifices)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Rahu in the 4th aspected by a malefic: suffering in domestic comforts (Jataka Parijata 12.139)
Association with a malefic: mother's distress (Bhrigu Sutras 9-10)
Braha: nodes in any kendra bring many major changes in life
lagna_or_context_notes: Ketu is in the 10th. Node dignity is disputed: Raman (Hindu Predictive Astrology) gives Rahu's exaltation as Taurus, while Braha says the only placements agreed upon are Mercury's signs Gemini and Virgo and treats Cancer and Leo as weak for the nodes.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (Mantreswara) 8.25 (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed. 1950)
source_views.view: Foolish, a cause of grief to others, short-lived, happy only at times (Sastri's text also has 'will have friends').

source_views.view: Rahu or Ketu in the 4th: many ornaments, two wives, serves others; with a malefic the mother is distressed, not so with a benefic.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani (Bhatta Narayana), 4th (Rahu) house, as quoted in the 'Other Views' of the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via quotation; original not read)
source_views.view: Mother sickly; in Aries, Cancer or Virgo Rahu gives beneficial results and the native becomes a king.

source_views.view: A malefic or Rahu in the 4th aspected by an evil planet makes one suffer in domestic comforts.

source_views.view: Foolish in behaviour, few friends, subject to fraud or guilty of fraudulent action.

source_views.view: Subordinate position, proficiency in European languages; also an indication of low associations.

source_views.view: Difficulties with a mother who may lead a troubled life; strong desire for land and home but negative for it; education difficulties; powerful cravings that disturb contentment; nodes in kendras bring major life changes. Gemini/Virgo: special homes, fine vehicles, strong beneficial mother.

source_views.view: In the 4th house Rahu is harmful to the mother (66) and gives enmity, e.g. disputes over relatives or property (81); Foss stresses these need not be literal.

summary: Rahu in the 5th is traditionally linked with obstacles concerning children (the 'serpent curse' motif), stomach complaints and a hard or unconventional mind, though some sources allow sharp intelligence and a son.
common_outcomes: Few, delayed or lost children, or sorrow through them (Phaladeepika 8.26; Bhrigu Sutras 11-13; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha; Foss name 77)
Stomach or abdominal complaints, colic, flatulence (Phaladeepika 8.26; Chamatkar Chintamani via Bhrigu Sutras; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Hard-hearted, narrow or unconventional thinking (Phaladeepika 8.26; Raman HJH; Hindu Predictive Astrology; Braha)
Troubled love affairs (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Childlessness attributed to a serpent's curse, remedied by worship of a Naga image (Phaladeepika 12; Bhrigu Sutras 11-13)
Speaking through the nose (Phaladeepika 8.26)
Chamatkar Chintamani (via Bhrigu Sutras): gets a son but worries over the spouse
Foss name 89: in the 5th Rahu gives penetrating, high intelligence

by_area.personality: Hard-hearted (Phaladeepika 8.26); mistaken by others and unfriended, hard-hearted and unconventional (Raman HJH); tyrannical yet polite, narrow-minded (Hindu Predictive Astrology); intelligent but troubled mind, practical, worldly (Braha).
by_area.career: Gemini/Virgo: excellence in sports, politics or crafts (Braha).
by_area.health: Belly-ache (Phaladeepika 8.26); colic and heart trouble (Raman HJH); windy diseases (Bhrigu Sutras 11-13); stomach ailments (Chamatkar Chintamani; Braha).
by_area.relationships: Disturbed love affairs (Braha); Raman HJH: Rahu afflicting the 5th gives strange courtships.
by_area.family: Childless or loss of children (Phaladeepika 8.26; Bhrigu Sutras 11-13); will lose a number of children (Raman HJH).
by_area.spirituality: Not much inclined to spiritual practice (Braha).

strengtheners: Rahu in Gemini or Virgo: extremely intelligent, powerful children, good relations with them (Braha)
